title: PieceDefinition
description: A chess piece TYPE. Instance state (remaining durability, rarity) lives in run.schema.json, never here: rarity belongs to an instance, not a type. What each tier adds is declared here in rarityAbilities. See docs/06-deck-durability-and-permadeath.md and docs/02 §2.3.

value.description: Chess material value (P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9), the same at every rarity tier. King is 0 and is never counted.

spawnCost.description: Spawn points one summon of this piece costs in the Deployment phase, at Normal rarity (docs/02 §5). Mirrors chess value. King 0 (always free); pawn nominal (never in the deck).

spawnCostByRarity.description: Per-tier overrides of spawnCost; may only raise it. Tiers not listed use spawnCost.

cost.description: Act I shop price in coins at Normal rarity. null = not purchasable.

durabilityMax.description: Summons per purchase at Normal rarity; the same for every deck piece (docs/06 §1). null = not a deck piece with durability (king: immortal; pawn: stage-only).

durabilityMaxByRarity.description: Per-tier overrides of durabilityMax. Tiers not listed use durabilityMax.

rarityAbilities.description: Abilities each tier ADDS on top of the lower tiers (cumulative). Normal never adds anything. Rules: docs/02 §2.3.

notes.description: Design intent. Not shown to players.

ability.description: Engine piece-ability primitive. Adding one is an engine change; see docs/09 §6.

text.description: One short sentence for the piece card (pillar 3).

allOf.$comment: The king is immortal, never sold, and has no rarity.
Pawns are stage-only: never sold, no durability, no rarity abilities (their rarity only sets the promotion result).
Every other piece is a purchasable deck piece with durability.
